part.name: Pocketed saddle block (thin-roof cradle)
part.description: Rectangular block with a concave cylindrical cradle on the top surface and a recessed underside pocket that exposes the underside of the cradle, leaving a thin constant-thickness roof. Overall BBox ~2 (X) x 6 (Y) x 1.5 (Z).
part.symmetry_note: Appears symmetric about the X=0 midplane (left/right) and Y=0 midplane (end-to-end).

Section.name: Outer perimeter frame (solid rim)
features included: Outer rectangular envelope (vertical side walls at X=±1)
Bottom mounting/support rim (annular bottom face around pocket opening)
Section.function intent: Provide the main structural body, external reference surfaces, and a stable base for supporting/mounting while carrying loads from the cradle roof into the base.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff perimeter ring/beam. Under vertical loading on the cradle, it takes compressive and bending loads, providing edge support to the thin roof and reacting forces through the bottom rim to whatever it sits on.
Section.geometry: Rectangular prism outer shell with a bottom planar face that is a ring (outer boundary with an inner rectangular cutout boundary). Outer sides/end faces are planar.
Section.location: Outermost boundary of the part: full-height outer side faces (X extremes), full-height end faces (Y extremes), and bottom perimeter at Z=-0.75.

major_faces.name: Bottom rim plane
major_faces.description: Bottom planar support surface at Z=-0.75 with an inner rectangular loop (pocket opening), forming a perimeter ring.

major_faces.name: Outer side +X
major_faces.description: Outer vertical planar side at X=+1 spanning full length (Y) and full height (Z).

major_faces.name: Outer end +Y
major_faces.description: Outer vertical planar end face at Y=+3 spanning full width (X) and full height (Z).

major_faces.name: Outer side -X
major_faces.description: Outer vertical planar side at X=-1 spanning full length (Y) and full height (Z).

major_faces.name: Outer end -Y
major_faces.description: Outer vertical planar end face at Y=-3 spanning full width (X) and full height (Z).

Section.name: Cradle roof (top seat + underside shell)
features included: Concave cylindrical cradle seat (top surface) for round stock/pipe
End top pads (flat regions at Z=+0.75) that terminate the cradle
Underside cylindrical shell visible from pocket (constant-thickness roof)
Underside end flats inside pocket at Z=+0.55 closing the roof at the ends
Section.function intent: Provide a shaped seating interface to locate/support a cylindrical mating part while maintaining low weight via a thin roof over an underside pocket.
Section.physical behavior: The concave seat spreads contact pressure across an arc, reducing local stress on the supported cylinder. The thin roof behaves like a curved plate/shell spanning between the perimeter frame and pocket walls, transferring vertical load into the surrounding structure primarily through bending and membrane action along the cylindrical curvature.
Section.geometry: Exterior concave cylindrical surface (axis along X) in the mid-length region, with planar top pads at both ends (Z=+0.75). Interior (pocket-facing) underside is a coaxial cylindrical surface with slightly larger radius, plus short planar end closures at Z=+0.55, indicating ~constant roof thickness (~0.2).
Section.location: Top central region (cradle) and the interior underside of that region exposed within the underside pocket.

major_faces.name: Top end pad -Y
major_faces.description: Top planar pad at Z=+0.75 near Y=-3 end (flat termination of the cradle).

major_faces.name: Top concave cradle cylinder
major_faces.description: Concave cylindrical seating surface on top; cylinder axis along X, spanning mid-length in Y.

major_faces.name: Top end pad +Y
major_faces.description: Top planar pad at Z=+0.75 near Y=+3 end (flat termination of the cradle).

major_faces.name: Underside end flat -Y (inside pocket)
major_faces.description: Interior planar roof face at Z=+0.55 near Y=-3 end, inside the underside pocket.

major_faces.name: Underside cylindrical shell (inside pocket)
major_faces.description: Pocket-facing cylindrical underside of the cradle roof; coaxial with top cradle, offset by thickness.

major_faces.name: Underside end flat +Y (inside pocket)
major_faces.description: Interior planar roof face at Z=+0.55 near Y=+3 end, inside the underside pocket.

Section.name: Underside pocket walls (inner cavity boundary)
features included: Inner vertical side walls at X=±0.8
Inner vertical end walls at Y=±2.8
Section.function intent: Reduce mass/material while maintaining a supporting frame; provide internal boundary surfaces that brace/support the thin cradle roof and define the pocket opening.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a set of stiffening webs/walls linking the bottom rim to the roof underside. These walls carry shear and local bending reaction from the roof, limiting roof deflection and distributing load into the perimeter frame and bottom rim.
Section.geometry: Four planar vertical faces forming an inner rectangle (pocket boundary) extending from Z=-0.75 up to Z=+0.55.
Section.location: Inside the underside opening: inset from the outer perimeter (X from ±1 to ±0.8; Y from ±3 to ±2.8).

major_faces.name: Pocket wall +X
major_faces.description: Inner vertical wall at X=+0.8 forming one long side of the pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket wall +Y
major_faces.description: Inner vertical wall at Y=+2.8 forming one short end of the pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket wall -X
major_faces.description: Inner vertical wall at X=-0.8 forming the opposite long side of the pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket wall -Y
major_faces.description: Inner vertical wall at Y=-2.8 forming the opposite short end of the pocket.
